_comment: Local dashboard settings. Paths are relative to the repo root (the folder above dashboard/).

runs._comment: Claude runs from the dashboard (plan_dashboard_v2). tasks.<id> can override model / effort / maxTurns / timeoutMin.

cloudSync._comment: Two-way sync with the website database (D1) through wrangler: every intervalMinutes, debounceSeconds after a local change, and after Sync. node dashboard/cli cloud-sync runs it by hand.

runRequests._comment: The website queue: buttons on the website (Process new jobs, Sync, Fetch description, Find R&D emails) insert a request in D1; this dashboard checks every intervalSeconds (heartbeat too), runs it like its own button and writes the outcome back. Needs cloudSync.enabled. Off with JOBWATCHER_RUN_REQUESTS=off.
